scope: Twenty-nine Lean sources rebuilt serially from a fresh scratch cache: five dependencies, twenty-three research modules and the umbrella. Includes actual equality-free CP/GIC composition and quotient Extensionality, semantic interpreted set-existence lemmas and fixed Power matrices, a complete numerical base-3 codec, literal-table INC/return execution, and actual first-order PSC/ZF0 equivalence. Optional NoQuotient254 has separate evidence. No full equality-free ZFC calibration, changed-calculus correctness, whole compiler simulation or end-to-end machine theorem is claimed.
